purpose: Durably represent one disposable execution of one prepared Work Item without requiring all workers to mutate a shared status object.
transition_rules: A fresh delegated worker creates its own run file; it does not edit another worker's run file.
STARTED must be durable before substantive job execution.
WORKING is optional and only for material frontier changes; no heartbeat loops.
DONE requires RETURNED or an equivalent return already durable.
BOUNDARY/FAILED require terminal_reason and enough evidence for parent recovery.
CANCELLED/SUPERSEDED are parent/steward-controlled terminal states when appropriate.

fields.launch_code: Human launch alias used for this run.
fields.frontier: Current unsatisfied execution frontier, compact and non-private.
fields.write_scope: Actual scoped write paths, if any.
fields.epoch_seen: Runtime EPOCH validated by this worker.
fields.conversation_ref: Optional platform chat/thread evidence if exposed; never required.

parent_projection: Parent/control compiler derives batch counts and run summaries from these independent objects plus RETURN existence; workers never directly set parent aggregate counts.
